title: Lior and the Wreck
author: Sebastian Whitlock
blurb: Elodie Delacroix, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
